description: This file contains the implementation of a balance sheet report in the ERPNext system, including functions to gather financial data, calculate provisional profit/loss, check opening balances, generate report summaries, and prepare chart data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate balance sheet report data, including data retrieval, calculations, and chart preparation.

methods.name: get_provisional_profit_loss
methods.description: Calculates provisional profit or loss based on asset, liability, and equity data over a period list.

methods.name: check_opening_balance
methods.description: Checks if the previous year's balance sheet is closed by evaluating opening balances.

methods.name: get_report_summary
methods.description: Generates a summary of total assets, liabilities, equity, and provisional profit/loss.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares chart data (bar or line) for visualizing assets, liabilities, and equity over periods.
